name: hr-connect

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix mobile test
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint

description: A premium, secure, cross-platform Human Resource Management System (HRMS) for iOS, Android and Web, featuring employee management, attendance tracking, leave management, payroll, recruitment, training, approvals and real-time workforce analytics.
author: dominic wokorach
